entities.name: Na+/K+ ATPase alpha
observations: Sequence aligns at 100% identity and 100% query coverage to reviewed Drosophila melanogaster UniProt P13607, sodium/potassium-transporting ATPase subunit alpha; query is 768 aa versus 1041-aa reference.
Reviewed homolog annotation assigns EC 7.2.2.13 and identifies the alpha subunit as catalytic; evidence is transferred by near-identical homology, not an independent assay of this sequence.

entities.name: Na+/K+ ATPase transport
observations: Rhea RHEA:18353 reaction: 2 K+(out) + 3 Na+(in) + ATP + H2O = 2 K+(in) + 3 Na+(out) + ADP + phosphate + H+; couples ATP hydrolysis to electrogenic sodium export and potassium import.
